name: antalyaweather
description: Antalya weather, sea temperature and beach conditions. Compare hourly and 14-day forecasts, wind and waves across Antalya's districts.

interface.longDescription:
See Antalya's weather, sea temperature and beach conditions in one interactive dashboard. Get current forecasts for 25 districts and resorts, including Kemer, Alanya, Kaş, Kalkan, Side, Belek, Lara and Konyaaltı, with feels-like temperature, humidity, wind and the day's maximum UV index. Plan your holiday and outdoor days with hourly, 3-day, 7-day and 14-day forecasts.

Check sea temperature, wave height and wind for 15 beaches along the Antalya coast, including Konyaaltı Beach, Lara Beach, Cleopatra Beach, Kaputaş Beach, Patara Beach, the Phaselis bays, Adrasan, Çıralı and Olympos. Compare two to four districts side by side to find the best area for your trip or beach day.

The branded cards use antalyaweather.com data and are available in English, Turkish, German, French and Russian. Weather and sea values are forecasts, and marine data may include fallback values. Check local conditions before swimming or other water activities.

Antalya Weather is also available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/antalya-weather/id6809961776

positive.description: Current weather and forecast for one district
positive.prompt: Show the weather forecast for Kemer.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_weather for Kemer. Shows the Antalya Weather dashboard with the current temperature, feels-like temperature, humidity, wind, the day's maximum UV index, an hourly forecast and a daily forecast, with the source update time.

positive.prompt: What will the weather be like in Alanya over the next 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_weather for Alanya with the 7-day period. Shows seven daily forecasts with conditions and high and low temperatures.

positive.prompt: Compare the weather in Kaş and Alanya.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_weather with Kaş and Alanya. Shows both districts side by side with current conditions and a 3-day forecast.

positive.prompt: Show Antalya beach sea temperatures and waves.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_sea_conditions. Lists Antalya beaches with sea temperature, wave height and wind, says the values are estimates, and does not claim that swimming is safe.
Calls get_weather for Konyaaltı with the Turkish locale. Shows today's weather for Konyaaltı in Turkish.
